summary: Time-traveling candy puzzles with Om Nom and his ancestors!
description:
TIME TRAVEL HAS NEVER BEEN THIS SWEET

Travel through history with Om Nom and meet his ancestors in a sweet puzzle journey all about getting candy to hungry monsters.

Cut ropes, solve clever physics puzzles, and feed two adorable Noms at once. It’s the classic Cut the Rope gameplay you love – with double the fun and new twists across colorful eras.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT

• 175+ physics-based puzzle levels starring two hungry Noms
• A single-player puzzle adventure packed with ropes, gadgets, and clever challenges
• 12 unique time periods, each with its own look, mechanics, and personality
• Collect stars, discover hidden treasures, and fun surprises
• Cute animations, charming ancestor characters, and signature Cut the Rope humor

TRAVEL THROUGH TIME

MEDIEVAL AGES 🛡️
Break chains with sharp blades in Crusader Nom’s castle. For the kingdom!

RENAISSANCE 🎨
Freeze time and dodge new tricks with Om da Nomci. A true masterpiece in motion!

PIRATE SHIP ☠️
Blast bombs and bounce candy on Captain Nom’s ship. Sugar ahoy!

ANCIENT EGYPT 🐫
Guide flying candy and rockets to TutankhaNom. Sweet offerings!

ANCIENT GREECE 🏺
Swap platforms and use portals with the Green Philosopher. Wisdom says: candy!

STONE AGE 🪨
Slide giant stones that move everything with Cave Nom. Ooga-booga!

DISCO ERA 🎶
Block bright beams with disco balls for Groovy Nom. Stay funky!

WILD WEST 🤠
Link candies with glowing ropes in Sheriff Nom’s desert. Yeehaw, sugar!

ASIAN DYNASTIES 🎎
Hide and reveal elements using the magical fan of WisdOmNom. Sweet harmony!

INDUSTRIAL AGE ⚙️
Snap magnetic candies together in Industrialist Nom’s factory. Candy power!

THE FUTURE 🤖
Move radio-linked candy with Future Nom’s robotic platform. Beep-boop yum.

PARALLEL UNIVERSE 🔮
Face a mega-mix of past mechanics with ParaNom. Everything’s weird!

Jump through time, feed the ancestors, and enjoy a candy-filled puzzle adventure full of creativity, strategy, and sweet moments!

PLAY CUT THE ROPE: TIME TRAVEL NOW AND SEE HOW SWEET HISTORY CAN BE!

Cut the Rope: Time Travel is free to download and play, but some in-game items are available for purchase with real money. For more information, please review our Terms of Use (https://www.zeptolab.com/terms) and Privacy Policy (https://www.zeptolab.com/privacy).
